metadata.description: Literature review skills for Claude: screening, evidence tables, cited synthesis, claim checks, and living reviews on Continua Project Rooms.

plugins.name: continua-literature-review
plugins.description: Continua Literature Review helps researchers, PhD students, R&D and medical affairs teams, and policy analysts review the literature in Continua Project Rooms. Screen papers against a written protocol with PRISMA 2020 flow counts, extract study data into an evidence table with every value cited to its page, synthesize themes, disagreements, certainty, and research gaps into a cited review or related work draft using up to 1B tokens of working context, check every claim and citation in a manuscript against its sources, and keep a living review current as new papers appear. Files are versioned with recoverable history. Connects to the Continua Project Room MCP server (https://app.askcontinua.com/mcp?subset=mini) and requires a Continua account; access and usage follow your account permissions and plan.
